content.comment_body: Does anyone have experience with the [product_name]? Mine appears stuck in configuration mode after a power loss (LED L is flashing). I can't access it through the web interface and even performing a factory reset doesn't seem to work. Thanks for any advice.

When the power LED 'L' flashes: initialization or reconfiguration is in progress. Did you hold down the SET button for more than 10 seconds to try resetting to factory settings? If that doesn't resolve it, I recommend submitting a support request.
Thanks for responding so quickly. I attempted both the 6-second and 10-second reset methods. I agree, raising a support request seems wise.
I managed to reset the device eventually. The button was misaligned and only made contact in a specific position.
Hello [user_name], Thank you for the update.

I'm experiencing the same issue... The [product_name] keeps re-initializing after a power outage, and communication with it fails. Is there a solution, such as updated firmware, or is using a UPS the only option? PROBLEM SOLVED!! Turns out the initialization failed to recognize the SIM card because there was NO PIN-CODE! Since we now use a SIM card with a PIN-CODE, there are no more problems with rebooting after a power outage.

Hi, Which internet browser are you using? I previously faced trouble with Internet Explorer. After switching to Firefox, it started working. My issue: I couldn't always open the Web page of the [product_name]; sometimes it appeared but I couldn't enter information, or some input fields were missing. The manual indicated support for Internet Explorer V11, Firefox V28.0, and Chrome V33.0. Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report problems with the [product_name] after power failures, including getting stuck in initialization or configuration, inaccessible web interfaces, and unsuccessful resets. Issues such as misaligned buttons and SIM card PIN-code settings also impact reliability. Browser compatibility for the web interface adds further confusion regarding supported browsers.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect reliable device recovery after power interruptions, successful hardware resets, helpful troubleshooting options, and consistent web interface functionality across recommended browsers.
